status: scoped research prototype; conditional capacity reduction
client: one serial trusted frontend; nonrollback private state; permanent fail-stop
backend_slot_horizon: 2^56, including initialization, dummy and group-reset slots
requirements: Frontend supplies exclusive canonical ownership; admitted address is absent from the backend.
Birth and retirement schedules, address replacement and slot counts are independent of ORAM random labels, bucket depths and stash occupancy.
Assign a fresh immutable uid at backend admission, even when payload returns from cache.
A parked admission label is independent, never previously exposed for that version, and never selected based on its value.
Full bit-reversal maintenance occurs every A backend slots. Neutral and read fusion do not advance gamma.
N_max includes all simultaneously possible backend canonical addresses, including unified recursive map blocks.
For grid reuse, N_max <= A*2^(L-1), h=L+1 is in the grid, and r=R-(A-1+root_omission_shift) is in range.
R0 root-omission shift equals Z. Only the root is omitted from maintenance.
All read openings and write acknowledgements use the frozen authenticated primitives. Any error permanently stops the frontend and its trees.
capacity_bound_scope: Conditional fixed-history stash bound in the secret ideal-label model. No fresh grid generation or full frontend cryptographic budget audit.

freecursive_variant.trusted_terminal: leaf of the final one-block map level
freecursive_variant.compressed_map: 64-bit GC plus X beta-bit ICs; address/GC/IC PRF-derived leaves
freecursive_variant.preemptive_reset: reset group before using an IC already equal to 2^beta-1

rho_variant.public_frame: 3 rho Path-tree slots, then 1 Full-backend slot, including dummies
rho_variant.rho_tree: Z=2 Path, R=maximum resident population; deterministic population stash bound

benchmark.keys: public reproducible test keys; not a secure deployment
benchmark.metric: actual serialized application request/response bytes with nonce, headers, authentication and control
benchmark.rpc: application request/response pairs; not measured network RTT
